items.title: Sete Lagoas (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 11 #03
items.en_title: Sete Lagoas (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 11 #03
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Sete Lagoas (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 175,035.47; proposals close Dec 11, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
